notes.title: [BETA] CHANGELOG| 1.1.78_a
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
here is the latest update. It's released on the BETA branch as we couldn't reproduce some bugs. We would be grateful for your feedback and information when you encounter problems or any issues. 

[h3]Changelog 1.1.78_a[/h3]
[quote]
[list]
[*]A reputation system has been added between the player and the NPC at sea. When a player has a low reputation among the NPCs, he will not help us or charge more for hauling away. The reputation between the NPCs can be viewed in the tablet in the scoreboard
[*]Added The ability to tow NPC ships to the port
[*]Added the option to grind the bait by crew members (they take the bait themselves from the fridge and grind it)
[*]Storm mechanics added. Storms occur in specific areas and move according to the direction of the wind. Swimming in will take damage and sink.
[*]Land and shoals added
[*]The option to receive radio messages has been added. After receiving it, it shows us the appropriate menu
[*]Added ship speed up option in debugger options to check for errors
[*]Added more information about the current crew status on the UI
[*]Added an option for the player to push the crew back for critical situations when they get stuck somewhere
[*]Fixed a bug with the ground information not being displayed on the map
[*]Fixed a bug with the crew catching frames
[*]Fixed a bug with NPCs that were influencing the land
[*]Fixed NPCs dropping frames
[*]The infinite world has been improved
[*]Fixed bolsters in the port
[*]Improved the sound of the feet in the port
[*]Improved game performance at sea
[*]Crew animation has been improved
[*]Fixed a bug with the second steak not being visible in the ship select screen
[*]Fixed the bug with the Crew panel overlap on the tablet map
[*]The icons on the sorting table have been improved
[*]Fixed a bug with the crewman throwing the hook
[*]Improved the transparency of the control panel (letters are better visible)
[*]The ship may become immobilized ashore
[*]Improved texture settings for buildings in the port
[*]Reduced-intensity of illumination (overexposure)
[*]The player can call for help by radio in order to be towed to the port
[*]The wind direction is displayed on the monitor at the helm
[*]The game world for terrain operation has been reduced and adjusted, fuel consumption, map distances, and enemy positions[/list][/quote]

notes.title: Game Update | 1.1.52
BETA Update | 18-01-2021
Pre-release Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
It will be short today but I wanted to inform you that we are working on next features from our roadmap and of course about bug fixing including Crew.

[h1]New Crab Species[/h1]
We are preparing 4 new crab species that will be available to catch. 3 of them will give you money, and one will be without value. Right now we are discussing making it possible to make a bait from crabs without value but we didn't decide yet.

So here are the new crab species: 
[list]
[*] Blue king crab (Paralithodes platypus)
[*] Golden king crab (Lithodes aequispinus).
[*] Scarlet king crab (Lithodes couesi)
[*] Snow crab (Chionoecetes opilio )
[/list]

And here you can see a few of them on the renders (click to zoom):
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/442f13f89e44d02efa6aeccab89e4bd0edbef7f0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/1812111965f53ac55d7511ea9d8e6f87b711216a.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/d21092cb020b24c5bb4692c86fcabf36b5eff6b9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/3297fc153231995ad3d0fbd9eae91e44487b0387.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/6698ee4dd95596d8fca9664613f7c596ebd81eac.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/98c3a9ae22bbee40f84d78a0df4b5d221c3ee63d.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/68d79607f8a1f1848830fd46ea41c47f9ed6a5f2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/e09cdacf48b2e087ef646fd93be18ccd8156aeb3.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/fa8fc0f73a657fad5377286bbb29a67e0e353a39.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/778a8891f3cf4fb387999cc7c2ba0e535a76f25c.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/97c47b66c8dbab9589a3bb0d2497496c5dffeb0e.png[/img]

[h1]Captain / steering room[/h1]
As many of you are waiting for this feature - I want just to confirm that we are preparing it. Here ar EARLY renders of how it looks. Please note that it will change, we are preparing new 3D monitors models, etc.

You will be able to turn on/off lights, turn on/off ship engine, use dynamic monitors, etc. In the feature, you will be also able to use the radio and receive in-game notification about the ex. storms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/383ab2abcac6a3deca92b4edfc70eb20683b01a6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/f70f55f69b76a3fb9b091b393ceeaee6c3a05d63.png[/img]

If everything will go fine  - the update will be available in the next 1-2 weeks. 

Regards,
Rafal

notes.title: [BETA] Game Update 1.0.6 / Beta / Steam cards
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
as you may know, we have a severe issue with save&load system and loading times. We were unable to localize the problem and we are tracking it for 4 days. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/9887753df0f137e4372affddff040f4e8c2739a1.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately, update 1.0.5 didn't solve anything and caused more issues as players reported. That is why we decided to launch a parallel branch called "BETA". You will be able to choose its in-game properties tab. Below you will find more information. 

[h1]BETA[/h1]
Public BETA branch will give us more detailed feedback about your problems. This game version is loaded with debugging code so we should (if you will send us) knew more about what is going on - when you occur any problems. 

As far as you have problems with Save&Load we raised up starting money in BETA up to 50,000$. 

[quote]1.0.4[list]
[*] Crew: fixed problem with unused crab pots,
[*] Fixed issue with missing (in a storm) pots,
[*] Manual: updated layout and removed duplicated chapters,
[*] minor localization fixes,[/list]
1.0.5[list] 
[*] Fixed issue with disappearing crab pot (when on the winch hook),
[*] Tutorial: fixed problem with the crane,
[*] Crew: fixed issue with crab pots on the second level of the cargo area,
[*] Incompatible version popup: added option to cancel loading,
[*] Save-data: added information about water temperature,
[*] performance improvements,
[*] raised starting money to 15k.[/list]
1.0.6
[list][*] Skills/Crew: higher sorting boost,
[*] Settings: default camera delay reduce,
[*] fixes to game stability,
[*] raised starting money to 50K.
[/list] [/quote]

[h1]HOW TO JOIN BETA[/h1]
Right-click on game name > properties. Switch to "BETAS" tab and choose "beta" from the dropdown list. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/d72704f9daaeb5f7c828ad7cd86454411f562f71.png[/img]

[h1]HOW TO LOCALIZE LOGS[/h1]
To help us find bugs and solve problems we need to have debugging/users logs generated by the game when it occurs any problems. We can't collect them automatically - that is why you have to send them to us by yourself. It is really - really important for us. By sending them to us you are giving us the necessary information to fix the game. 

You can do it in two ways:
[olist]
[*] Download our simple script (100% safe) - it will open logs directory: [url=https://deadliestcatchgame.com/tools/]https://deadliestcatchgame.com/tools/[/url]

[*] Search files by yourself [code]C:/Users/%username%/AppData/LocalLow/Moonlit/DeadliestCatch[/code]
[/olist]

Then you have to send these logs to us: [b]support@moonlit.games[/b]

[h1]STEAM CARDS, ICONS & BADGES[/h1]
We also have just released a set of cards, icons, background and badge. You should receive them already if you have played the game if you didn't - you have to play the game a bit more. 


[i]Regards,
Rafał - COO in Ultimate Games S.A.[/i]

notes.title: Full Game Release (1.0) - Changelog
notes.notes:
Ahoy Captains!
Today we are leaving the Early Access! It's a BIG day for us and we hope you will like all the changes we have made and which we are introducing today.

Early Access was a real challenge not only for us but also for you - players. We want to thank you for all your patience, those nice (and unpleasant) words and your wonderful support! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/c5610a613d1e5dc71c916683c6960b1f0f0bcc38.jpg[/img]

There is one thing that we didn't introduce yet but it will be released as FREE DLC soon - new ship based on F/V Northwestern. Unfortunately, we weren't able to finish all programming due to some delays caused by bugs.

Anyway, we are finally here! We made it together and we hope you will stay for more than ONE season!

I almost forgot! We "tuned up" storm weather - so please, be aware that some of you may have nausea ...:>

[h1]DEMO[/h1]
We have also make a demo version of the game - so you can try it for free...but remember you will have locked a lot of gameplay features.

In February we plan to bring you another feature that you've asked a lot about - multiple seasons with the captain's skills. We are sure that this feature will bring you much more fun in playing Deadliest Catch: The Game coming from the proper progression. More vessel upgrades are planned for March - as well as the Steam integrations and the Kickstarter in-game rewards :)

We'll do our best to fulfill this pan in a timely manner, but please have in mind, that there still may be some changes during the development.

See you on the Bering Sea!

notes.title: Development Progress - update note
notes.notes:
[b]Ahoy fearless Captains![/b]

Today we’d like to tell you a little about our current focus and the upcoming features, that will get implemented in Deadliest Catch: The Game. So here’s what we’ve been up to. :)

Recently, we’ve been working on the major update for one of the most important features - the crew management system. As you all well know, currently there are three workers available, each performing a specific task. With the upcoming update, we are going to put much more decisions in your hands, captains!

First of all, we will provide you with a very useful tool to manage your ship - the tablet. Within the tablet, there will be a special panel designed to manage your crew. There you will be able to see your available crewmen and assign them to tasks of your choice. All the actions will be connected with “work loops” - either preparing the pots or collecting pots from the water (the third loop for your sailors is resting). While your crew is working on their assignments, you can check the progress of each task on the tablet.

After this major update, we will be developing the tablet feature furthermore, including the full information panel within it, for example helping you keep track of all your items in the storage or the issued fines. In time, the tablet will become a true command center of your vessel. :)

When we got the tablet figure out, we’ll proceed to develop another awaited features - progression. We intend to implement multiple seasons, so all the money and resources you’ve gathered will pass between them. The same goes for the upgrades and captain’s skills (more of those will be available in the future). So that’s how your career in crab fishing goes!

See you soon on the Bering Sea!

notes.title: Deadliest Catch: The Game - Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Everyone on BOARD!!![/h1]

[b]An important day for our game is here! Today, November the 14th, we released Deadliest Catch: The Game in the Early Access on Steam! From now on you can purchase and play our game via Steam and participate in creating it by your feedback. :)[/b]

Like we’ve done many times before, we’d like to start with a huge thank you to our community - all the Kickstarter backers, pre-alpha testers, members of our Discord server. Your involvement, support, and feedback have been (and still are!) a tremendous help to us all. We are sure that we wouldn’t be able to do many, many things with this project if it wasn’t for you all! :)

That being said, let’s now focus on the Early Access release itself. So what has changed in comparison to the demo version that you were able to play up to this point? First of all, we implemented two important features that you were often asking about - save system and the full tutorial. As for the crew management system, the main goal of our successful Kickstarter Campaign, we are starting with the basic version of it and we will keep developing it during the Early Access period.

We expect the Early Access to last about 4 to 6 months, mostly depending on the progress with the development. Our main short-term goals for the first weeks will be polishing the current state of the game and fixing bugs reported by players and beta-testers, as well as looking into the matters pointed to us during the Kickstarter Campaign. From there on, we intend to focus on the equipment wearing off and the dynamic mechanics of the fisheries; as well as captain’s tablet that will help you manage your ship, crew, and skills (starting with the basic version of it).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33963706/aff40968beb74339c4d15f299f4250057c788f56.jpg[/img]

But we have a lot more on the horizon. :) We’d like to bring your captain’s experience to the new level with a career mode consisting of the consequent seasons in which you will upgrade your ship and gain new skills while earning money and catching up to the AI competition. There will be a bunch of cosmetic changes, like setting the name of your captain, ship, and ship’s coloring presets; fully functional wheelhouse (with some changeable music on the radio); all the cool Kickstarter rewards (like hidden in-game messages); a pop-up information system, that will keep you posted on the situation on the Bering Sea and so on. In the meantime, we will be doing localization for various languages.

As we stated earlier, the crew system - probably the most anticipated feature - will get enriched in the future updates. We want to implement a fatigue system that will make managing your crew more advanced. Then the next step will be improving the employment system (for example allowing you to pay your crew a share of your income). Finally, we intend to make the Bering Sea more dangerous (and the catch more deadly). Waves, equipment malfunctions, ship damage … and possibly some accidents that can occur to the crewmembers.

You can check the planned Development Road Map for Deadliest Catch: The Game [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/838630/discussions/0/1639802081893080787/]HERE.[/url]

Of course, we will keep you posted about the updates and the changes implemented in them. Please let us know what you think by leaving recommendations and comments on the Steam discussion pages. If you haven’t joined our Discord server yet - [url=https://discord.gg/zwTX9Mb][b]go for it :)[/b][/url] It’s the best place to share your feedback or ask questions about games! Also, please report to us all the bugs you’ve encountered. The game is still in the development and some problems may (and probably will) happen at first - but we’ll do our best to deal with them as soon as we can. 

[b]See you at the Bering Sea, Captains![/b]

notes.title: Deadliest Catch The Game - Kickstarter UPDATE - CAMPAIGN POSTPONED
notes.notes:
Dear DC fans!
 
As you may well know, we have faced some technical issues with launching the Kickstarter campaign. Those additional days of waiting for approval allowed us to take a deep breath and run closed beta-test with a group of gamers. During those, we learned that there is still a lot to improve in the demo of our Alaskan waters adventures.

Because we take your feedback very seriously and we want to make this game as good as we possibly can, [b]we came to a difficult decision - to postpone the campaign[/b] until we’ll be sure that it'll meet your expectations.  After all, with the Deadliest Catch show, we have a lot to live up to!
We realise, that a lot of you can hardly wait that long and want to help us and support the development as soon as possible. We're extremely grateful for that! That’s why [b]we decided to start a wider closed beta-tests and invite all of you[/b], the early supporters to join them.

[b]Everyone who joins our Discord Server ( https://discord.gg/zwTX9Mb ) and sends a message on the #beta-testing channel, we’ll send a Steam key for the current, early alpha demo of the game. We’ll close the enrollment on Monday, June the 17th (counting as 23:59 UTC).[/b]

We hope that with your support we can make the game we will all be proud of!

notes.title: UPDATE: Kickstarter Campaign
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATE: 
Hello DC fans! 
Due to the technical issues with the Kickstarter, we have to postpone the launch of the campaign. It should be resolved in a few working days - we'll state the exact date (day and hour) as soon as will get the information from Kickstarter.
We're sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience![/b]



[h1]Ahoy fearless captains![/h1]

Today we come back to you with the long-promised information about the [b]Deadliest Catch: The Game Kickstarter Campaign[/b]. As we’ve told you in the last announcement, we have decided to go on Kickstarter, in order to gather funds for additional in-game features - foremost the crew management, that you strongly rooted for. It took us some time to prepare for the campaign and estimate what can we actually do with additional funds and within the time we have for finishing the project.

[b]That being said, we can announce, that the Kickstarter Campaign will launch on June 7th 2019. You can see the campaign page (be aware it’s still in development!) here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/matthewwieckowski/677960236?ref=4x6ovi&token=1e198c3f][/url]. Don’t forget to check the notification icon on top![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yTFKj6u.gif[/img]

As we promised, the main goal of the campaign will be implementing the crew management mechanics in its basic form. When you’ll hire a crewman, you’ll be able to assign him to a chosen task on deck - for example setting the pots or sorting the caught crabs. As he’ll keep performing the given task, he’ll get better at his job, doing it faster and more efficient. Additionally, when the crewman will be free for the moment, he’ll perform secondary actions, like preparing the bait or repairing the equipment.

We have some additional features planned from the start, so they make a place in the stretch-goal list. Among them you can find improvement of the crew management mechanics (f.e. the crewmen will get tired as they work on deck) or equipment upgrades. We’ve also included one of the big features that you were oftenly asking about - the multiplayer mode! :)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fc8L7ox.gif[/img]

As for the campaign rewards, we’ve prepared multiple options for you. From getting copy of the game at a better price, through access to beta-tests and digital posters, to exclusive rewards like placing hidden objects in the game or naming a captain after you - we’ve got you covered. In any case, look out for the limited early-bird (or in our case, the early-crab) rewards, cause you’ll be able to get a sweet deal out of them.

We hope that you are as hyped for this campaign as we are - please share the good news with your friends and if you have any questions, don’t hesitate to ask them here! :)
